description.text: The second Sword & Shield set, released on 1 May 2020 with 209 cards: 192 and 17 secret rares. Its 15 Pokémon V include Toxtricity V, Dubwool V and Boltund V, and its seven Pokémon VMAX the final forms of all three Galar first partners, Rillaboom, Cinderace and Inteleon, with Copperajah VMAX and Dragapult VMAX. It also has four new Special Energy.
